features.name: Knowledge Base Ingestion
features.description: Load and index approved customer-support knowledge-base content for retrieval.
acceptance_criteria: Indexed content is available to retrieval

features.name: Knowledge Retrieval
features.description: Retrieve relevant KB evidence for a customer question.
acceptance_criteria: Retrieval results are passed to generation
Absence of evidence does not become unsupported factual content

features.name: Grounded Answer Generation
features.description: Generate customer responses using retrieved KB evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Answers are based on retrieved evidence

features.name: Confidence Assessment
features.description: Determine whether retrieved evidence is sufficient to answer safely.
acceptance_criteria: Low-confidence requests are not answered as facts

features.name: Layered Escalation Logic
features.description: Escalate when the agent cannot provide a sufficiently grounded or authorised answer.
acceptance_criteria: The agent does not fabricate to avoid escalation

features.name: Human Escalation Response
features.description: Return a clear response when a request must be handled by a human.
acceptance_criteria: Customer is told human assistance is required
Requested action is not falsely claimed complete

features.name: Chat API
features.description: Expose the agent through a backend /chat API.

features.name: Structured Logging Foundation
features.description: Provide structured application logging for agent execution.
acceptance_criteria: Errors contain diagnostic context without secrets

features.name: Phase 1 Behavioural Evaluation Suite
features.description: Validate that the agent answers when it can and escalates when it cannot safely answer.
acceptance_criteria: Escalation cases cover distinct failure modes
